name: Sikorsky S-61 / SH-3 Sea King
summary: A big twin-turbine helicopter with a boat-shaped hull; flown by offshore, firefighting and heavy-lift operators and as the Navy and Marine Sea King.

wings: Five-blade main rotor on a thick mast
engines: Two turboshafts side by side above the cabin on the roof
Round intakes and exhausts forming a hump over the cabin
fuselage: Boat-shaped hull with sponsons on each side, retractable wheels folding into the sponsons
Land-only version has no sponsons and fixed wheels
Round nose with a big windscreen and a long cabin with a row of windows
tail: Upswept tail pylon that folds on the Navy version
Tail rotor on one side of the pylon with a horizontal stabilizer

tellTales: Boat-shaped hull with a big sponson on each side
Five-blade rotor above a hump of two roof-mounted engines
Long, round-bellied cabin with a canted tail pylon

confusedWith.howToTell: The S-92 has a four-blade rotor and a modern boxy fuselage with a rear loading ramp; the S-61 has five blades and a rounded boat-shaped hull.
The S-58 has a nose-mounted engine and a four-blade rotor; the S-61 has two turbines on the roof and five blades.
The MH-60 has four blades, a canted tail rotor and no boat hull; the S-61 has five blades and a boat-shaped body.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
